metaTitle: Custom Embroidery Sports Gear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom embroidery sports gear from Perfect Imprints. Perfect for teams, events, and corporate giveaways. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Embroidery adds a professional, durable finish to sports gear that screen printing or patches can't match. Whether you're outfitting a company softball team or ordering staff polos for a charity 5K, stitched logos resist fading and peeling through repeated washing and active use. Our embroidered sports gear includes performance hats, moisture-wicking polos, and fleece jackets with your logo sewn directly into the fabric. Choose from dozens of thread colors to match your brand palette exactly.
heroAltText: Custom embroidery sports gear with stitched logo on a performance polo shirt and baseball cap
